plan: Given my private value of $19, the goal is to bid below this value to ensure a positive profit if I win. To maximize long-term profit, I'll bid slightly lower than my value to reduce the risk of overpaying. A bid around $15 increases the chance of winning against opponents who might bid close to their value while still ensuring a profit margin. This strategy balances the trade-off between winning and maintaining profitability.
